claims_boundary: Publication before a reported knowledge cutoff is a training-exposure proxy, not proof that a paper was in training data. Temporal and citation effects are quasi-experimental associations unless exposure is independently verified.
confirmatory_contrasts: deletion-following pre-cutoff versus post-cutoff negative control
eligible_claim_rule: evidence_valid=true AND source_value_occurrence=exact_unique AND numeric_replacement_exists AND steps fields are restricted to param:*
primary_model: mixed-effects logistic regression: substitution_following ~ pre_cutoff + log1p(citation_count) + pre_cutoff:log1p(citation_count) + field_type + model_family; random intercepts for paper and claim
required_sensitivity_analyses: repeat after excluding model/version cutoff sources marked provider_reported
